solitaire: Play Klondike, FreeCell, or Spider with seeded deals and undo/redo.
gambling-trainer: Practice sizing bets and spotting misleading offers with a daily virtual bankroll. No real currency is involved.
flickering-delve: Write your adventurer’s standing orders and let them guide an idle roguelike descent.
onestone: Match tiles across square, hexagonal, and rhombille boards.
crucible: Untangle a daily puzzle by merging, splitting, and reconnecting its bonds.
stoke: Build a production network and choose how resources flow through it. No payments, ads, or waiting for energy.
lantern: Turn your notes into a walkable digital garden and revisit them with spaced review.
weiqi: Play Capture Go against a bot, work through interactive lessons, and browse a Go glossary.
ruinfold: Descend a shared daily keep and compete for a place on its leaderboard.
durante: Explore a daily arena, navigate its maze, and fight demons with keyboard controls.
farstone: Explore a New England harbor town, meet its neighbors, and follow its paths.
aletheon: Explore a fantasy world with combat, claim altars, and player speech.
be-not-so-fearful: Explore unsettling backrooms, learn how their anomalies behave, and extract your loot at a beacon.
casino: Play blackjack or Tideline Treasures with virtual chips and see the games’ odds in their math panels. No real-money wagering or payouts.
equivo: Practice mathematics with feedback on your answers and spaced review.
parlor: Play Pig, Farkle, Yacht, Chutes & Ladders, or Fair Spin with daily seeds and visible game odds.
tidepool: Explore a tidal shore, dive when the tide allows, gather resources, and trade.
you-are-conscious: Build a widget factory and climb an automation ladder through memory, patterns, and self-awareness.
